main_issue: Who deals with the unwashed pan with pork fat, and whether the household agrees a rule to wash the pan (and clean up) right after use

A-B.evidence: A and B both denied using the pan (T1-2), and both later agreed to the wash-immediately rule (T13, T16), but they never addressed each other.

A-C.evidence: C said whoever used it should sort it out (T9). A denied it was them (T11) and agreed to the rule (T13). C agreed to the rule and extended it to all cleaning (T18).

A-D.evidence: A asked D about the special cleaning (T5, T7). D proposed the wash-after-use rule and A said 'Fine... good idea' and 'Yes' (T11, T13).

B-C.evidence: B said 'Yeah, fine' to the rule (T16) and C said 'Yes' with an extension (T18), but they did not address each other.

B-D.evidence: D asked B directly (T14) and B agreed 'Yeah, fine' (T16).

C-D.evidence: C wanted the pan user to sort it out (T9), while D said they would do the cleaning this time (T10). C then agreed to D's rule and broadened it (T18).
